messages:
sofia: FYI — Sales escalated a latency/throughput report from ZenWave after last runtime change. They say p95 and occasional 5xxs went up during heavy chat sessions :warning:
aj: link to the customer ticket is in CRM and support ticket TKT-9987. They included two failing request ids: rw-zen-20260315-11 and rw-zen-20260315-12
sofia: minimal repro they sent in the ticket: a long multi-turn chat (~4k tokens) at burst QPS. They attached a curl with payload.
sofia: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-3b","input":"<big history>","max_tokens":1024}'
```
liam: grabbing logs now. Early hint: KV cache thrash + batching latency path. I can see cache rebuilds around rw-zen-20260315-12 and a flurry of eviction noise.
maya: ZenWave is on a Dedicated pool (zenwave-dedicated-3) with committed capacity. This is P1 for SaaS health if not fixed fast. We need a mitigation + roadmap item.
liam: immediate mitigation: reduce batch window and force latency-optimized execution for that pool. That trades some throughput for tail latency. We can do this per-pool, so it won't affect other customers.
aj: can we guarantee no noisy-neighbor blast? They confirmed they have their own GPU pool, right?
liam: confirmed — per-customer pool. No shared tenancy for zenwave-dedicated-3. Safe to tweak.
maya: propose we create an operational ticket for the mitigation and a separate engineering ticket for the eviction bug. Draft acceptance for the mitigation so product can sign off.
sofia: support already updated the customer with a short-term plan and asked for a same-day test window. They've agreed to run a synthetic load this afternoon.
liam: estimate: mitigation rollout + canary = ~4 engineer-hours. Eviction refactor is non-trivial — roughly 2-3 sprints with infra + runtime QA.
maya: suggested artifacts:
- OP-2011 (mitigation) apply per-pool batching cap + latency route (canary -> zenwave pool -> monitor 12h)
- ENG-2012 (bug) refactor KV eviction to avoid full-cache rebuilds on long contexts
Acceptance for OP-2011: 12h canary with p95 <= 3s and 5xx rate back to baseline under reproduced load.
aj: ZenWave asked for an ETA. Can we commit to same-day canary?
liam: I can own OP-2011 and run the canary today EOW. Will post dashboard link when live.
devops-bot: deploy request queued: pipeline OP-2011-canary (build #4528) — status: queued
liam: canary is live on zenwave-dedicated-3, dashboard: https://infra.redwood/dash/zenwave/OP-2011
liam: preliminary: p95 down to ~2.4s, 5xxs back to baseline. Throughput at same load dropped ~15%.
maya: that meets product acceptance for the mitigation. Liam leave it observing for 12h and collect synthetic + customer traffic graphs.
sofia: support will send hourly interim updates to ZenWave during the 14:00-16:00 PST test window. I'll add rollback steps to the ticket.
liam: rollback command if we need it:
```
redwoodctl pool-config apply --pool zenwave-dedicated-3 --from backup-config-20260310
```
liam: rollback ID: rollback-OP-2011-1
aj: CRM note: flagged account as "at-risk" (CRM-3830). I'm scheduling a partner call during the test window.
maya: next steps for product roadmap: add OP-2011 to backlog as P1 customer-sla-intake with owner Liam and target immediate canary. Add ENG-2012 (eviction refactor) as P2 on the 3-month roadmap with a prototype in sprint 1.
sofia: I've stubbed the runbook and customer comms template in the ticket. Support will handle updates until product takes over after canary.
liam: if OP-2011 stays green for 12h, I'll mark it resolved and we can follow up with throughput optimization work with ENG-2012. If not, escalate to full rollback and triage.
maya: thanks everyone. Product will prepare post-mortem notes and a rollout playbook. I'll also add quantifiable launch criteria to the roadmap card.
aj: update sent to ZenWave. They're relieved we have a plan and will run verification this afternoon :thumbsup:
support: monitoring live on our side too, will raise immediately if anything regresses.
liam: monitoring summary will include p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, and tokens-per-second. I'll post screenshots after 1h and at the 12h mark.
maya: good. Closing loop once canary completes; product will draft customer-facing summary and schedule ENG-2012 scoping.
sofia: noted and will keep the ticket updated. Thanks team :heart:
